label: post-indefinite-article token detector
explanation: It fires almost deterministically on the token immediately after an indefinite-article form (a, an, A, another, including spacing/capital variants), and also on an initial a/A at position 0. It is strongest for lowercase " a" triggers in early positions, especially [START] a ..., and weaker for other article forms, later positions, and spillover to adjacent punctuation/function words. It does not fire on non-initial articles or on tokens not following such an article except for this weak spillover.
